mappings.applicability_reason: This threat describes potential interception and tampering of customer ticket content, translated notes, and the workspace API token while they are transmitted between the connector service (cmp-001) and the helpdesk API (cmp-002) on data flow df-003. req-DATA-001 applies because the system transmits confidential customer data and credentials over a network, and protection of that data in transit (with identification of who provides it) is directly relevant to whether this threat is mitigated.

documentation_gaps.title: Encryption of connector–helpdesk API traffic is undocumented
documentation_gaps.description: The integration description states that the connector authenticates to the helpdesk using a workspace API token with full workspace access but does not state whether traffic between the connector service (cmp-001) and the helpdesk platform (cmp-002) is protected with TLS or any other transport encryption. As a result, it is not possible to determine from the available documentation whether customer ticket content, translated notes, and the workspace API token are protected in transit on data flow df-003 in the context of threat thr-004 (network interception of connector–helpdesk API traffic).
documentation_gaps.importance: Clarifying transport encryption on the connector–helpdesk path is necessary to assess the confidentiality and integrity of tickets and the workspace API token for threat thr-004 and to evaluate compliance with requirement req-DATA-001.
requested_evidence: Architecture or integration documentation stating whether connector–helpdesk API traffic on data flow df-003 uses HTTPS/TLS or another transport encryption mechanism.

Details of certificate validation and endpoint authentication for the helpdesk API connection, if TLS is used (for example, whether standard certificate validation is enforced and any pinned identities).
Network or deployment diagrams showing how the connector reaches the helpdesk (for example, whether this path traverses the public internet, a VPN, or a private link).
